# neobrutalistcomponents

> Brutalist React components. Five themes, light and dark, one token contract. React 19, zero runtime dependencies, cascade-layered CSS driven by a closed --nbc-* token contract.

Version 1.0.0. Install with `npm install neobrutalistcomponents`, import `neobrutalistcomponents/styles.css` plus one theme stylesheet, and wrap the app in `<NeoProvider theme="…">`.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://sssamuelll.github.io/neobrutalistcomponents/#/start): install, setup, fonts, bring-your-own theme
- [Themes and tokens](https://sssamuelll.github.io/neobrutalistcomponents/#/themes): the five themes, every token, live contrast ratios
- [Blocks](https://sssamuelll.github.io/neobrutalistcomponents/#/blocks): complete screens composed from the components

## Actions

- [Button](https://sssamuelll.github.io/neobrutalistcomponents/#/components/button): A pressable slab that performs an action: four variants, three sizes on the shared control scale, a loading state and icon slots.

## Forms

- [Checkbox](https://sssamuelll.github.io/neobrutalistcomponents/#/components/checkbox): A real native checkbox drawn as a brutalist box with check and mixed glyphs, with its label, description and error message built in.
- [Input](https://sssamuelll.github.io/neobrutalistcomponents/#/components/input): A single-line text field with its label, description and error message built in, on the shared 32 / 40 / 48px control scale.
- [RadioGroup](https://sssamuelll.github.io/neobrutalistcomponents/#/components/radio-group): Pick exactly one option from a small visible set: a fieldset with a legend whose Radio children are native radio inputs drawn as brutalist dots.
- [Select](https://sssamuelll.github.io/neobrutalistcomponents/#/components/select): A native dropdown with its label, description and error message built in, a drawn chevron, and a fully themed list wherever the browser supports it.
- [Switch](https://sssamuelll.github.io/neobrutalistcomponents/#/components/switch): A native checkbox with the switch role, drawn as a brutalist track and thumb, for settings that take effect the moment they flip.
- [Textarea](https://sssamuelll.github.io/neobrutalistcomponents/#/components/textarea): A multi-line text field with the same label, description and error API as Input; it grows with its content, starting from `rows` lines.

## Display

- [Alert](https://sssamuelll.github.io/neobrutalistcomponents/#/components/alert): An inline message about the state of the page or a task: four variants with a status icon and edge stripe, an optional title, action and dismiss button.
- [Badge](https://sssamuelll.github.io/neobrutalistcomponents/#/components/badge): A small sticker that labels a status or a category: seven variants, two sizes, and room for a leading icon.
- [Card](https://sssamuelll.github.io/neobrutalistcomponents/#/components/card): A bordered slab that groups related content, composed from Card.Header, Card.Title, Card.Description, Card.Content and Card.Footer.
- [Kbd](https://sssamuelll.github.io/neobrutalistcomponents/#/components/kbd): A keyboard key cap for shortcuts in docs, menus and tooltips, in two sizes.
- [Progress](https://sssamuelll.github.io/neobrutalistcomponents/#/components/progress): A bar that shows how far a task has gone, or that it is still running when the end is unknown: four variants, three sizes, an optional label and percentage.
- [Table](https://sssamuelll.github.io/neobrutalistcomponents/#/components/table): A styled data table with native table semantics: a scroll wrapper, two densities, optional stripes, and alignment helpers for numeric columns.

## Overlays

- [Dialog](https://sssamuelll.github.io/neobrutalistcomponents/#/components/dialog): A modal dialog on the native <dialog> element: focus trap, Esc, inert background and top layer come from the platform. Controlled only.
- [Tabs](https://sssamuelll.github.io/neobrutalistcomponents/#/components/tabs): Switch between views that share one place on the page, composed from Tabs.List, Tabs.Tab and Tabs.Panel. Follows the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern with automatic activation.
- [Tooltip](https://sssamuelll.github.io/neobrutalistcomponents/#/components/tooltip): A short hint attached to a focusable element, shown on hover after a delay and immediately on keyboard focus, rendered in the top layer.
